title: The Exodus and the Christian Life
subtitle: Egypt, the sea, the wilderness, the Jordan and the battles in the land, and how the New Testament reads them as the shape of following Christ
summary: "These things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us" (1 Corinthians 10:11). Israel's road out of Egypt is the oldest map of the life of faith: bondage and a Passover, a sea crossed, a wilderness of provision and testing, a river, and a land with battles still in it. Zoom into any stage to see where the New Testament finds Christ in it, applies it to the believer's walk, or holds it up as a warning. Notes say when a mapping is a long-standing devotional reading rather than a stated one.
